input.description: Show git auth and worktree source files
Find uses of the auth helper and token

groups.summary: Substring host check leaks GitHub service token to lookalike remote hosts
groups.reason: Both tickets describe one defect. In src/git-auth.ts:8, gitAuthArgs decides whether to add the service token by checking `remoteUrl.includes("github.com")`. cloneRepo in src/worktree.ts:15 is the only caller: it passes the user-supplied repo.remoteUrl and SERVICE_TOKEN to gitAuthArgs, then runs `git clone` against that URL. Replacing the substring check in gitAuthArgs with a parse of the URL's hostname and an exact match on github.com fixes both tickets. Because anyone who can register a repository can collect the token, this is an exploitable token leak.

groups.summary: Substring host check leaks GitHub service token to lookalike remote hosts
groups.reason: Both tickets describe one defect. In src/git-auth.ts:8, gitAuthArgs decides whether to add the service token by checking `remoteUrl.includes("github.com")`. cloneRepo in src/worktree.ts:15 is the only caller: it passes the user-supplied repo.remoteUrl and SERVICE_TOKEN to gitAuthArgs, then runs `git clone` against that URL. Replacing the substring check in gitAuthArgs with a parse of the URL's hostname and an exact match on github.com fixes both tickets. Because anyone who can register a repository can collect the token, this is an exploitable token leak.
